reviewed_by: Codex alpha.19 clean-install failure and alpha.20 recovery review
reason: The failed alpha.19 preparation proved installation and desktop self-test on Ubuntu, Debian, and Kali, then exposed one shared workflow mismatch: Playwright stages full Chromium as chrome under --no-shell, while the smoke gate searched only for headless-shell executables. Three focused packaging contracts verify synchronized alpha.20 metadata, the release CLI contract, and that the protected clean-install workflow discovers and launches the staged full Chromium binary.
exclusions: No full suites. The source change is limited to release metadata, notes, one protected-workflow executable selector, and its packaging contract assertion. Product code, UI behavior, provider integrations, state lifecycle, native runtime behavior, and browser journeys are unchanged; the reviewed accumulated release matrix runs again during protected preparation. Physical package installation is supplied by the protected Ubuntu, Debian, and Kali clean-smoke jobs.
